adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, `uniqueGuests` filters out emails already in `booking.attendees` and blacklisted emails. If nothing remains, it throws `TRPCError({ code: "BAD_REQUEST", message: "emails_must_be_unique_valid" })`. This message key maps to "Emails must be unique and valid" and is surfaced to the user in AddGuestsDialog via `t(err.message)`. When the provided emails are valid but all are already attendees (or all are blacklisted), the error text is misleading, though it doesn’t break core functionality.
